text: dsh-ui-zoom-regions 是一款面向 DSH 网页客户端的界面插件，可分别调整会话顶栏、左侧栏、会话正文和右侧面板的缩放比例，并单独拖动顶栏下边缘改变其占用高度。它通过鼠标所在区域的 Ctrl+滚轮、键盘快捷键和右下角读数控件调整缩放，提供单区及全部重置；缩放比例和顶栏高度保存在浏览器本地。适合需要放大界面文字、调整布局空间或改善可读性的用户。

dsh-ui-zoom-regions independently scales the DSH web header, sidebars, conversation body, and right panel. Use Ctrl+wheel or shortcuts over a region, or adjust levels in the corner readout. Drag the header edge to resize it separately. Zoom and header settings persist in browser storage.
想把 DSH 侧边栏和对话区的字号分别调大。
有没有办法只缩小右侧面板，不影响聊天正文？
让会话顶栏和正文使用不同的缩放比例。
DSH 网页里的字太小，能用滚轮放大当前区域吗？
我想拖动顶栏边缘来改变它占用的高度。
如何把界面缩放恢复到默认大小？
Can I zoom the sidebar without changing the chat area?
I want to resize the conversation header independently of its text.
dsh-ui-zoom-regions 的功能「分区缩放」：分别调整顶栏、左栏、对话正文和右侧面板。指针位于目标区域时按 Ctrl 并滚动鼠标滚轮，也可用 Ctrl 加快捷键缩放或重置。
dsh-ui-zoom-regions 的功能「顶栏高度」：拖动顶栏下边缘可独立改变顶栏占用空间，双击恢复样式表高度。高度与顶栏文字缩放分开保存。
dsh-ui-zoom-regions 的功能「缩放读数」：右下角控件显示各区域比例，并可切换自动、常显或关闭模式；Ctrl+Alt+0 也能切换显示模式。
dsh-ui-zoom-regions 的功能「保存缩放设置」：区域比例及顶栏高度写入浏览器 localStorage，重新载入后继续使用已保存值；读数模式则每次载入回到自动。

dsh-ui-zoom-regions README · dsh-ui-zoom-regions：Per-region UI zoom for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`).
The shell's regions get **independent zoom levels** instead of one page-wide scale, and the
conversation header's whole bottom edge can be dragged — nothing is painted there, the cursor just
changes — to make that header shorter or taller.

[中文说明](#中文说明) · [Install](#install) · [Controls](#controls) · [How it works](#how-it-works)

dsh-ui-zoom-regions README · Regions：| Region | What it zooms | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top | the conversation header: title row (session title, preset badge, header actions) and the view tab row (`Chat` / trajectory / plugin views) | one level for both rows, so every label stays on screen |
| Left | the sidebar column | skipped while the sidebar is collapsed to the icon rail, restored on expand |
| Centre | the conversation body (scroll area + composer) | deliberately **not** the whole column, so the header above it can never be dragged along |
| Right | the right sidebar column (files, terminal, browser, document preview …) | independent of the centre column |

dsh-ui-zoom-regions README · Regions：Zoom is applied as CSS `zoom` on the target element, so a region keeps its width: content reflows
and scales, neighbouring columns are untouched, and the splitter drag handles stay where they are.

dsh-ui-zoom-regions README · Controls：- `Ctrl` + mouse wheel — zoom **the region under the pointer** (captured, so the page never scrolls)
- `Ctrl` + `+` / `=` — zoom that region in · `Ctrl` + `-` — out · `Ctrl` + `0` — reset it to 100%
- Range 50 %–200 % for the centre column; the two sidebars (and the header's font) go
  **25 %–300 %**; wheel step 5 %, key/button step 10 %
- The header's **bottom edge** is a second, independent control — **drag it down** to give the
  header more room, **drag it up** to collapse it (down to 24 px; a row that no longer fits vanishes
  whole, so no line is ever cut in half), **without touching the font**; double-click hands the
  height back to the stylesheet

dsh-ui-zoom-regions README · Controls：The readout in the bottom-right corner shows all four levels. It is hidden by default and only
appears for about two seconds after a change (`pointer-events: none` while hidden, so it never
blocks the UI). Its last chip cycles the readout mode — auto / always / off — and `Ctrl + Alt + 0`
does the same from the keyboard.
dsh-ui-zoom-regions README · The header: two independent controls：The conversation header carries **two separate channels** — this is the whole point of 1.2.0:

dsh-ui-zoom-regions README · The header: two independent controls：| | Font size | How much room it takes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Control** | `Ctrl` + wheel / `Ctrl` + `+ -` `0` over the header | drag the header's bottom edge |
| **Stored in** | `dsh-ui-zoom-regions/levels` (`top`) | `dsh-ui-zoom-regions/headerHeight` (px) |
| **Range** | 25 % – 300 % | 24 px … half the conversation panel |
| **Effect** | title row + tab row scale | `min-height` when growing; `height` plus whole rows dropped when collapsing |

dsh-ui-zoom-regions README · The header: two independent controls：They never interfere: shrinking the labels no longer shrinks the bar, and making the bar taller no
longer enlarges the labels.

**The bottom edge.** Its **entire width** is the drag target: an invisible 9 px band just inside the
bottom edge that paints nothing and only switches the cursor to `ns-resize`. No handle to hunt for.

dsh-ui-zoom-regions README · The header: two independent controls：- The pointer moves the edge one pixel per pixel — drag 20 px and the header is 20 px taller or
  shorter.
- **Dragging up really shrinks it, one whole row at a time.** `min-height` is only a floor: it can
  never make the header shorter than its content, which is why pulling up used to do nothing at all.
  Below the natural height the plugin writes `height` and drops the rows that no longer fit **whole**
  (`display: none`; the tab row goes first, then the title row) — a row that stays on screen keeps
  its own font size, its padding and its share of the layout, and nothing is ever sliced through the
  middle of a line. `overflow: hidden` stays on only as a backstop.
- Limits are measured on every drag: at least **24 px**, at most **half the conversation panel**
  (the panel is resolved through `*_centerCol`, then the nearest ancestor meaningfully taller than
  the header, then the window). The live numbers are recorded as `headerHeight` / `headerLimits`
  in the diag receipt.
- **Double-click** returns the header to the stylesheet's own height (removes the inline
  `min-height`, `height` and `overflow`).

dsh-ui-zoom-regions README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:FurinaEsE/dsh-ui-zoom-regions

dsh-ui-zoom-regions README · desktop profile：dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:FurinaEsE/dsh-ui-zoom-regions
```

The package ships plain JavaScript and runs no install scripts, so there is no build-approval step.

dsh-ui-zoom-regions README · Storage：Everything is local and per browser origin:

| Key | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh-ui-zoom-regions/levels` | `{ top, left, center, right }` zoom factors |
| `dsh-ui-zoom-regions/headerHeight` | the header occupancy in px (absent = the stylesheet height) |
| `dsh-ui-zoom-regions/diag` | a small diagnostic receipt (version, timestamp, which regions resolved, applied zoom values, `headerHeight`, `headerLimits`) |

dsh-ui-zoom-regions README · Storage：The readout mode is deliberately session-only: every page load starts in `auto`, so a mode picked
earlier can never lock you out of the readout.

dsh-ui-zoom-regions README · How it works：`lib/index.js` is an empty host half. All behaviour lives in the browser half, which resolves the
shell's regions from stable hooks — `[class*="_sidebarCol"]`, `[class*="_centerCol"]`,
`[data-rightbar-col]`, `[class*="_titleRow"]`, `[data-conversation-tabs"]` — and re-resolves them on
a slow interval plus a mutation observer, so panels that React re-creates (the right sidebar, the
header after a session switch) get their level re-applied and a target that disappears never leaves a
stale `zoom` behind.

dsh-ui-zoom-regions README · Credit and licence：MIT. The browser half started from [`imdeniil/dsh-ui-zoom`](https://github.com/imdeniil/dsh-ui-zoom)
(MIT), which zooms the whole document. This package reworks it into per-region zoom with its own
grip, persistence and readout; the upstream copyright notice is kept in [LICENSE](LICENSE).

dsh-ui-zoom-regions README · 中文说明：给 DeepSeek Harness 的界面做**分区缩放**：不再只有一个整页比例，而是会话顶栏、左侧栏、会话正文、
右侧面板各自独立；顶栏的**整条下边界**还可以直接拖动，把顶栏调矮或调高——边界上不画任何东西，
只有鼠标靠近时光标变化。

dsh-ui-zoom-regions README · 区域：| 区域 | 缩放对象 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 顶 | 会话头部：标题行（会话名、预设徽章、右侧动作图标）+ 视图标签行（对话 / 轨迹 / 插件视图…） | 两行共用一个比例，标签一个都不会消失 |
| 左 | 左侧栏 | 折叠成图标栏时自动跳过，展开后恢复 |
| 中 | **会话正文**（滚动区 + 输入区） | 刻意不缩整栏，所以上方的顶栏永远不会被带着放大 |
| 右 | 右侧面板（文件、终端、浏览器、文档预览…） | 与中栏互不影响 |

缩放用 CSS `zoom` 作用在目标元素上：**区域宽度不变**（内容重排并缩放，不抢相邻区域的空间，也不移动
拖动分隔线）。

dsh-ui-zoom-regions README · 操作：- `Ctrl` + 滚轮：缩放**鼠标指针所在区域**（捕获阶段拦截，不会滚动页面）
- `Ctrl` + `+` / `=` 放大、`Ctrl` + `-` 缩小、`Ctrl` + `0` 重置该区域
- 中栏范围 50%–200%；**左右两个侧栏与顶栏字号 25%–300%**；滚轮步长 5%，快捷键/按钮步长 10%
- 顶栏还有**第二条独立通道**：**向下拖**给它更多空间、**向上拖把它收起来**（最低 24px；放不下的行整行消失，
  不会把字切成半行），**完全不动字号**；双击交还给样式表高度

右下角读数默认隐藏，只在你调整时浮现约 2 秒（隐藏时不拦截点击）；最后一个按钮切换读数模式
（自动 / 常显 / 关闭），`Ctrl + Alt + 0` 等效。模式只在当次会话有效，刷新必定回到「自动」。

dsh-ui-zoom-regions README · 顶栏：两条互不干扰的通道：1.2.0 起，顶栏拆成两条独立通道：

| | 字号 | 占多高 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **怎么调** | 悬停顶栏按 `Ctrl` + 滚轮 / `Ctrl` + `+ -` `0` | 拖动顶栏**下边界** |
| **存在哪** | `dsh-ui-zoom-regions/levels`（`top`） | `dsh-ui-zoom-regions/headerHeight`（px） |
| **范围** | 25% – 300% | 24px … 对话区高度的一半 |
| **影响** | 标题行 + 标签行的缩放 | 放大时用 `min-height`；收起时用 `height`，放不下的行整行隐藏 |

两者永远不互相牵连：缩字号不会再缩矮顶栏，把顶栏拉高也不会放大文字。

**下边界**：整条宽度都是拖动区 —— 一条透明 9px 带子，贴在顶栏内底边，不画任何像素，只把光标变成
`ns-resize`，没有需要寻找的小把手。
section: 顶栏：两条互不干扰的通道

text:
dsh-ui-zoom-regions README · 顶栏：两条互不干扰的通道：- 指针移动多少像素，边界就跟着走多少像素（拖 20px = 顶栏高/矮 20px）。
- **向上拖是真收缩，而且是整行整行地收。** `min-height` 只是下限，永远没法把盒子压到比内容更矮 —— 这就是
  以前往上拖像卡住的原因。低于自然高度时改写 `height`，放不下的行**整行隐藏**（`display:none`，先收标签行、
  再收标题行）：留下来的行字号、内边距、占位全都不变，永远不会出现半行字。`overflow:hidden` 只作兜底。
- 上下限每次拖动都实测：最小 **24px**，最大 **对话区高度的一半**（先取 `*_centerCol`，再沿祖先找
  明显高于顶栏的容器，最后回退窗口高度）。实际值记在 diag 回执的 `headerHeight` / `headerLimits`。
- **双击**把顶栏交还给样式表自己的高度（移除行内 `min-height`、`height`、`overflow`）。
